technical_definition.text: Total (apparent and real) losses, expressed in terms of annual volume lost per service connection per day.

decision_rule: Do not select a candidate from public KPI text alone.

If neither candidate satisfies G2, remain in synthetic/shadow research and do not announce funded positions.
